```lean
induction n with d hd,
  { intro hn, rw [Nat.add_right_self], exact Nat.le_refl 2 },
  { intro hn,
    have h1 : 2 * 2^d = 2^(d + 1) := by rw [Nat.pow_add, Nat.pow_one],
    calc
      (d + 1) + 1 ≤ 2^d + 1
      ≤ 2 * 2^d
      = 2^(d + 1)
    by {
      exact hd,
      apply Nat.add_le_add_left,
      exact Nat.one_le_pow 2 d,
    }
  }
```
